notablePrerequisites:
Moritte of the Frost on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Moritte of the Frost do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Moritte of the Frost.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Moritte of the Frost.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
